authority.task: Prepare single-rack inputs, boundaries and acceptance before six-rack CDU development

final_design_sources.filename: 00_26025项目高密度液冷数据中心建设方案_v9_客户确定方案_20260926.docx
01_方案介绍_中文_v9_客户确定方案_20260926.docx

source_precedence: 00 and 01 are final. 02 and later are historical/process references only; references inside 00/01 do not blanket-approve their entire contents. Conflict between 00 and 01 must be reported, not silently resolved.
document_locator_convention: Bnnn is the 1-based top-level word/document.xml body child used during read-only extraction; not a rendered page number.

rack_path_hot_dp_reference_pa.location: design rack path; actual interface and valve split require confirmation

preliminary_assumptions_and_missing_data.required_before_dynamic_dispatch: Register exact assumed values/ranges, cases, sampling, fault times, numerical tolerances, stop conditions and source hashes. Do not silently copy a six-rack volume, UA, pump head or controller threshold.

stages.boundary: Explicit inlet temperature and flow source; finite rack inventory when registered; no CDU/source capacity claim
checks: steady enthalpy limit and transient stored energy
measured inlet and computed return remain distinct
mass and pressure continuity if a hydraulic case is enabled

stages.boundary: One rack, explicit recirculation and engineering heat-removal boundary, actuator, measurement, unchanged M1, project control/Safety and simulated PLC
required_cases: inlet overtemperature and independently checked protection
checks: Actual actuator state drives hydraulic flow and energy update
Measurements drive decisions; no future command visible to PRE
PRE/Safety/PLC/POST immutable bindings and fault latch
No IT derate used to satisfy full-load cooling
Supply hard limit failure recorded separately from correct protective response

stages.entry_gate: SR-A and SR-B evaluated against pre-registered gates; unresolved thermal failures remain explicit and block corresponding thermal readiness
stages.boundary: Six racks, common manifolds, actual coupled flows, heat exchanger and primary/secondary pump heat
stages.note: 1100kW is selected CDU capacity, not injected IT heat. Add pump heat once; use an actual or explicitly assumed HX map, not a forced capacity pass.

acceptance_rules.numeric: Independent mass/energy/pressure residuals with pre-registered scale-aware tolerances and step refinement; no tuned tolerance after observing failure
acceptance_rules.causality: No future input; correct actual issuer and immutable PRE/Safety/PLC/POST
acceptance_rules.thermal: Measured/physical rack inlet <=45C throughout claimed full-load acceptance window; target44C assessed separately; a protection latch alone does not make temperature pass
acceptance_rules.missing_design_or_OEM_data: INCOMPLETE for corresponding equipment claim; conditional development can proceed only with labeled registered assumptions
acceptance_rules.repeat: Exact source/input/environment-bound fresh repeats; no old PASS borrowed
acceptance_rules.full_development_delivery: Fresh full registered single-rack development suite in controlled remote runner after implementation; actual Job identity and cleanup, official artifacts and logs independently reviewed
acceptance_rules.aggregate_pass: FORBIDDEN when thermal, causality or equipment evidence remains failed/incomplete

final_design_group_requirements_deferred.source_pump_candidate: 115m3/h @34m candidate, actual normal about110m3/h each; not the historical PID max18m alternative
final_design_group_requirements_deferred.recharge: FINAL_SHARED_SOURCE_SEGMENTED_RECHARGE_WITH_OPTIONAL_FOURTH_SOURCE_PUMP_RECOVERY; no added independent recharge pump; no simultaneous separate A/B wet sources;440m3/h is example only
final_design_group_requirements_deferred.scope: Group-source/tank requirements, NOT single-rack cooling or single-rack fault-detection timer; do not divide a group tank by18 and call it designed rack inventory

preservation.old_results: Preserve as source-bound historical development results, not relabeled final-design acceptance
